verdict.rationale: The Pipecat Cloud API is documented as managing "regions", which suggests a product-level region choice. The OSS framework is also verified as pip-installable and self-hostable, so users can control where pipeline data lives. Neither source explicitly documents data-residency guarantees or region selection for stored data such as recordings and transcripts. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency documentation, a list of available regions and how to select them per agent or session, guarantees on where stored artifacts reside, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
